description: gleam_rules.ml: detect_non_exhaustive_case (line 256, Warning 'Case expression has only 1 branch — likely missing Error variant') and detect_redundant_single_case (line 929, Hint 'Case with only one branch — use a let binding instead') both fire on the same single-branch case, emitting contradictory advice. If the scrutinee is Result/Option-producing, the missing-variant warning is right and the let-binding advice is wrong; otherwise the redundant-case hint is right. Consolidate into one rule that inspects the scrutinee, or make redundant_single_case skip cases the other rule claims. Update golden fixtures accordingly.
title: Consolidate contradictory single-branch case rules
